messages:
Maria Chen: FYI PR #8459 is ready for merge, fixes the longseq p95 regression we saw in canary. Bench artifacts linked below. Need 2 approvals before the 09:30 PT merge window. Can we also agree on a staggered canary to avoid alloc spikes?

Bench highlights: (full run: https://bench.internal/runs/8459)
```
base: p50=120ms p95=420ms mem=4.1GB
candidate: p50=118ms p95=340ms mem=3.9GB
notes: p95 improved on longseq, small-batch p95 up ~5% but mem down ~200MB
```
Plan: canary at 5% for 10m, then 20% for 15m if tail stable, then full. Rolling window: stagger 30s between hosts to smooth alloc churn.

Sam: :eyes: quick skim — curious about the small-batch p95 bump. Do we have the microbench for 4k vs 256 token mixes?

Maria Chen: yep, microbench links: https://bench.internal/mb/8459-4k and https://bench.internal/mb/8459-256
Short excerpt: `4k: p95 1.2s -> 1.18s (candidate) ; 256: p95 90ms -> 95ms (candidate)`
Also ran the alloc-profile, attaching top allocers: `kv_cache_shard` reduced usage, `prefill-buffer` slightly higher.

Kevin: looked at the flamegraphs. microbatch mem delta ~+80MB on small-batch, but longseq path reduced ~180MB. That aligns with the mem numbers. If we stagger starts it should avoid simultaneous buffer growth.

Anita: I can run the small-batch smoke in staging now (5m). Will report back within 10.

CI Bot: ci/canary-check — all checks passed. canary-smoke: ok, perf-regression: warning (small-batch p95 +5%).

Sam: thx. If staging smoke is clean I'm +1. Also add a fallback policy to revert-to-previous if p95 increases >8% during canary.

Maria Chen: agreed — added automatic rollback rule and alerting to the rollout config. Config snippet:
```yaml
rollout:
  steps: [5, 20, 100]
  rollback_if: p95_increase_pct > 8
  step_duration: 10m
  stagger: 30s
```

Anita: staging smoke: small-batch p95 92ms (baseline 90ms) — no errors, memory stable. I'm OK to approve after one more 👀.

Sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

Kevin: LGTM — will watch canary closely and ping if tail moves. :rocket:

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — scheduling merge for 09:30 PT and will kick off the staggered canary immediately after. Will post canary links and a short postmortem if anything odd shows up. :tada:
